title: Focus-wheel interface authoring through Wright
summary: Normal Wright workspace and actual isolated engineering run. No mocked routes or physical action.

manualSteps.label: Open workspace
manualSteps.instruction: Open the isolated engineering proof workspace and click Workflows.

manualSteps.label: Choose workflow
manualSteps.instruction: Click Workflow files, then Open workflow, and choose the saved retained wheel preparation workflow.

manualSteps.label: Working view
manualSteps.instruction: Click Use saved process and open the recorded run link.

manualSteps.label: Recover preview
manualSteps.instruction: Open the recorded built preview-tab link, click Create or choose interface, then Open preview.

manualSteps.label: Save
manualSteps.instruction: Inspect the actual read-only results, click Create or choose interface, then Save interface.

manualSteps.label: Open saved
manualSteps.instruction: Click Open saved interface and inspect the retained preparation results.

steps.label: Workspace offers Workflows
steps.purpose: Verify the normal workspace route with real API owners.
steps.expected: The workspace loads and offers Workflows.
steps.actual: Normal workspace and Workflows control visible.

steps.label: Workflows opens the editor
steps.summary: The established workflow editor is available inside the workspace.
steps.purpose: Verify actual workspace entry without mocking.

steps.label: Workflow file controls
steps.summary: The workspace offers named saved workflows.
steps.purpose: Use the existing saved file chooser.

steps.label: Choose the wheel workflow
steps.summary: The exact accepted wheel workflow appears in the saved files.
steps.purpose: Choose the engineering process by its saved file.
steps.expected: The accepted wheel workflow is listed.

steps.label: Heat workflow diagram
steps.summary: The original wheel assignment opens with its connected review, CAD and analysis stages.
steps.purpose: Keep authoring and working views on the accepted source.
steps.action: Choose the accepted wheel workflow file.
steps.expected: Accepted heat diagram and working view action available.
steps.actual: Exact saved heat source is open.

steps.label: Shared working view
steps.summary: The process working interface opens in another Wright workspace tab.
steps.purpose: Verify shared inputs and readiness without creating another executor.
steps.expected: Common working view in a workspace tab.

steps.label: Attach the actual wheel run
steps.summary: The working view reads the same isolated backend run.
steps.purpose: Use actual process state for interface composition.
steps.action: Reopen the recorded wheel run link.
steps.expected: The common working view attaches without starting another run.

steps.label: Built wheel interface recovered
steps.summary: Wright restores the existing actual-model job and its built revision.
steps.action: Open the recorded preview tab and click Create or choose interface.

steps.label: Retained wheel evidence in preview
steps.summary: Generated preview reads actual retained engineering results in a Wright workspace tab.
steps.purpose: Prove actual results in the managed preview.
steps.expected: Read-only preview with actual result cards.
steps.actual: Preview connected with actual result cards.

steps.label: Wheel interface saved
steps.summary: Exact previewed build is saved as a reusable interface.

steps.label: Saved wheel view opens
steps.summary: Saved view uses the same retained failed run and actual evidence.
